'''Han''' is the clan chief of the [[Shorara]] sept of the [[Tomanelle]] [[Aiel]]. 

==Appearance and Personality==
He is about six feet tall and weighed 210 pounds. He has white hair and a face like wrinkled leather.

He is irascible and touchy about his height, which was short for an Aiel, had a sour mouth and often sounded unhappy or disgruntled. Prickly and difficult to know.{{ref|{{twotc|Han}}}}

==History==
He has a sour disposition.

==Activities==
He is present at [[Alcair Dal]] when [[Rand al'Thor]] declares himself ''[[Car'a'carn]]'' the same time [[Couladin]] does.{{ref/book|4|57}} After this he takes his clan to [[Rhuidean]] while waiting for all the rest of the clans to gather there.{{ref/book|5|2}}

He leads his Aiel clan when he is sent to the [[Plains of Maredo]] when Rand gathers a massive army in preparation for the attack on [[Illian]].
